title: Medicine cold-chain outage plan
summary: Protect temperature-sensitive medicines without guessing whether an overheated or frozen product remains usable.
content: Working sequence: Keep the container closed, log time and temperature, avoid direct contact with loose ice, use the established storage plan, and contact a pharmacist or manufacturer for product-specific decisions.
